title: SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (Internet Communication Manager) do not perform…
description: SAP Web Dispatcher and SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (Internet Communication Manager) have insufficient request validation in certain administrative functions. An unauthenticated attacker can trick a logged-on administrator into visiting a malicious link, causing unintended actions in the administrator's session. Exploitation can lead to full compromise of the underlying operating system, severely impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
